verdict.acceptance_for_round_3: Engine._titleApply('new') reaches writ.stamp with a composed character, driven only through real input from the title, and `node tools/journey/census-newgame.mjs` exits 0 with player_can_finish_creation true. The race the player ends up with must itself be something the player chose or the body already had — supplying a hardcoded default would satisfy this tool and fail RI-CHR01 §1 row 2.
